messages:
Priya: Dropped a one-pager draft called "Shield Slate" 1: enterprise quick-read on security, SLA bullets, and deployment choices. Need a tech sanity check + recommended CTA. doc: https://docs.google.com/d/xyz789
Ethan: Reading now. Nice layout. Two quick asks: add a short benchmark blurb and a 1-sentence on graceful degradation strategy (fallbacks/rollouts).
Lena: For inbound routing, I can wire automatic attachments for any lead that checks "enterprise" or "SLA required" on the form. We should also flag any "on-prem" requests as high-touch.
Ethan: Benchmark suggestion (sample callout): "p95 request latency: ~150ms (typical gen workloads); estimated hosted unit cost: ~$0.02 per 1k tokens. Dedicated deployments reduce per-unit cost by ~40% depending on utilization." Keep it short.
Priya: Perfect. Can you also add a 20s webinar talking point that ties to the brief? We want something we can read on stage and drop as the slide caption.
Ethan: 20s talking point: "Many teams hit a tradeoff between latency, cost, and compliance. Redwood's serving runtime lets you pin SLAs, pick secure network modes (VPC/on-prem), and use smart fallbacks to keep your app live during upgrades or capacity events."
Lena: Inbound routing pseudo-config (pseudocode):
```
routes:
  - match: form.fields.includes("SLA required") OR lead.tags.contains("enterprise")
    action: attach("Shield-Slate-onepager.pdf")
    assign: enterprise-ops
    priority: P1
  - match: form.request.contains("on-prem") OR form.request.contains("air-gapped")
    action: assign(solutions-engineer); notify(security@redwood.com)
  - otherwise:
    action: assign(growth-sdr)
```
Lena: Also adding an SDR note template: "Lead requires SLA discussion; attach Shield Slate and request scoping call."
Priya: CTA options for the one-pager (microcopy):
- "Download Shield Slate: SLAs & secure deployment checklist"
- "Get a quick SLA scoping call"
Priya: I want the first as the primary gated CTA; second as a follow-up for high-touch leads.
Ethan: Microcopy nudge for form button: "Download: Shield Slate (1 page)" keeps it clear and low-friction.
Lena: For webinar tie-in, I suggest the follow-up email include the brief + a short benchmark card image (one stat + 1-line benefit). We'll need an art asset request to design that card.
Priya: Action items: Ethan to paste benchmark & 20s line into the doc, Lena to push routing rules into inbound playbook + SDR auto-attach, Priya to pick CTA and finalize copy. Target: finalize by Fri 4pm PT.
Ethan: I'll add the benchmark and the line now. ETA 2pm.
Lena: Routing pushed to playbook, SDR auto-attach created. ETA 3:30pm.
Priya: I'll finalize CTAs and publish the one-pager. Then schedule the webinar promotion + social posts.
OpsBot: Calendar: "Shield Slate launch review" Friday 10:00 AM — invite sent to Priya, Ethan, Lena.
